title: Competition
subtitle: 競爭，究竟是哪一種「較量」？
description: 競爭，究竟是哪一種「較量」？

words.note: 最直接、最常用的近義詞之一，表示參加者互相比較表現以爭取勝出。
words.example: More than fifty students entered the writing contest.
words.exampleZh: 超過五十名學生參加了寫作比賽。

exercises.original: More than fifty students entered the competition to submit the best short story.
exercises.zh: 超過五十名學生參加比賽，爭取提交最佳短篇故事。

options.explanation: prize = prize 是勝出後得到的獎勵，不是學生可以 entered 的賽事。
exam = 寫作活動是互相比較作品，不是統一測驗知識。
contest = 學生提交作品並比較優劣以決出最佳短篇故事，這是典型 contest。
performance = 作品表現會被評比，但 performance 不是比賽本身。
competitor = competitor 是參賽者，不是活動。
cooperation = 參賽者在爭取最佳作品，不是共同完成同一目標。

exercises.original: The photography competition received more than two thousand entries.
exercises.zh: 攝影比賽收到超過二千份參賽作品。

options.explanation: game = 攝影作品評比不是 game。
prize = 收到的是 entries，不是獎品本身。
opponent = opponent 是人。
contest = entries 是作品型競賽的典型線索，因此 photography contest 最自然。
exam = 不是考試。
conflict = 沒有爭執或衝突意味。

exercises.original: She won first place in a national science competition.
exercises.zh: 她在全國科學比賽中取得第一名。

options.explanation: performance = performance 可被評分，但不能說 win first place in a performance。
competitor = 是參賽者。
prize = 可 win a prize，但不是 in a prize。
cooperation = 不表示第一名。
contest = won first place 表示參賽者按表現排名，因此 contest 是自然替換。
exam = 全國科學 competition 未必是考試。

words.note: 表示由多場比賽組成、通常有多名參賽者或多支隊伍角逐冠軍的賽事。
words.example: The school hosted a regional chess tournament.
words.exampleZh: 學校舉辦了一項地區國際象棋錦標賽。

exercises.original: The university is hosting a chess competition involving sixteen teams over three days.
exercises.zh: 大學正舉辦一項為期三天、有十六支隊伍參與的國際象棋賽事。
exercises.upgrade: tournament · 錦標賽；淘汰賽／系列賽

options.explanation: contest = 可泛指競賽，但 sixteen teams + three days 暗示多輪賽事，tournament 更精確。
prize = 不是活動。
game = 只是一場，不足以涵蓋三天多隊賽事。
tournament = 十六支隊伍在三天內參賽，明顯是由多場比賽組成的 tournament。
exam = 不是考試。
opponent = 是對手。

exercises.original: They reached the final of the international tennis competition.
exercises.zh: 他們打入國際網球錦標賽決賽。
exercises.upgrade: tournament · 錦標賽；淘汰賽／系列賽

options.explanation: match = 可以 reach a final match，但原句是整項國際賽事。
game = 單場比賽太窄。
prize = 不是賽事。
performance = 不是活動。
tournament = reached the final 表示此前有多輪比賽，因此 tournament 最貼切。
conflict = 不是衝突。

exercises.original: The competition begins with group matches before moving to the knockout stage.
exercises.zh: 這項賽事先進行分組賽，之後進入淘汰賽。
exercises.upgrade: tournament · 錦標賽；淘汰賽／系列賽

options.explanation: contest = 太泛，不能突出 group matches + knockout stage 的賽制。
race = 不是速度或目標競逐。
exam = 不合。
cooperation = 不合。
challenge = 可作挑戰賽，但此處有明確錦標賽賽制。
tournament = group matches 和 knockout stage 是 tournament 結構的直接線索。

words.note: 強調兩個人、團隊、企業或群體之間持續存在的競爭關係，而不是單一賽事。
words.example: The rivalry between the two clubs has lasted for decades.
words.exampleZh: 兩間球會之間的競爭關係已持續數十年。

exercises.original: Competition between the two clubs has remained intense for decades.
exercises.zh: 兩間球會之間的競爭關係數十年來一直很激烈。

options.explanation: tournament = tournament 是賽事，不會持續數十年。
contest = 單一 contest 不表示長期關係。
game = 一場 game 不會延續 decades。
cooperation = 和 intense competition 相反。
rivalry = for decades 表示持續多年的對抗關係，因此 rivalry 最準確。
prize = 完全不合。

exercises.original: There is fierce competition between the two technology companies.
exercises.zh: 兩間科技公司之間存在激烈競爭。

options.explanation: challenge = challenge 偏單次任務或挑戰，不表示兩公司的持續對抗。
match = 不是一場比賽。
exam = 不合企業語境。
performance = 不是關係。
cooperation = 意思相反。
rivalry = 兩間公司長期互相爭奪市場，fierce rivalry 是自然搭配。

exercises.original: Their competition began when they were junior players and continued into their professional careers.
exercises.zh: 他們的競爭從青少年球員時期開始，一直持續到職業生涯。

options.explanation: rivalry = 從 junior players 到 professional careers 的長期競爭最適合稱為 rivalry。
tournament = 不會由青少年時期一直持續成同一賽事。
game = 太短期。
prize = 不是關係。
opponent = 是人而不是關係。
challenge = 不能自然表示長年競爭。

words.note: 當 competition 強調測試能力、要求參加者完成困難任務時，可用 challenge。
words.example: The coding challenge attracted teams from twelve universities.
words.exampleZh: 這項編程挑戰賽吸引了十二間大學的隊伍。

exercises.original: The coding competition requires teams to solve five problems in six hours.
exercises.zh: 這項編程比賽要求隊伍在六小時內解決五道問題。

options.explanation: tournament = 沒有多輪對賽結構。
rivalry = 不是兩個固定對手之間的長期關係。
prize = 不是任務。
opponent = 是人。
cooperation = 雖然隊內合作，但整項活動是能力挑戰。
challenge = 參賽者要在限時內完成困難任務，重點是能力測試，因此 challenge 最準確。

exercises.original: The design competition asked students to build a bridge using only paper and string.
exercises.zh: 設計比賽要求學生只用紙和繩建造橋樑。

options.explanation: challenge = 特定限制下完成設計任務，典型可稱 design challenge。
race = 不是速度競賽。
tournament = 不是多場對賽。
performance = 作品表現會被評估，但不是活動名稱。
conflict = 沒有衝突。
exam = 雖測試能力，但形式是創作任務。

exercises.original: The fitness competition encourages participants to complete thirty workouts in thirty days.
exercises.zh: 健身挑戰鼓勵參加者在三十天完成三十次鍛煉。

options.explanation: championship = 沒有爭奪冠軍的明確線索。
challenge = 三十天完成三十次鍛煉屬完成目標型活動，因此 fitness challenge 最自然。
tournament = 沒有多輪比賽。
rivalry = 沒有固定對手。
prize = 不是獎勵。
opponent = 不是人際對抗。

words.note: 表示為爭奪冠軍頭銜而舉行的重要賽事或系列賽。
words.example: She qualified for the national swimming championship.
words.exampleZh: 她取得全國游泳錦標賽的參賽資格。

exercises.original: She qualified for the national swimming competition that determines the country's champion.
exercises.zh: 她取得全國游泳冠軍賽資格，該賽事會決出全國冠軍。

options.explanation: championship = determines the country's champion 直接指向 championship。
contest = 太泛，不能突出 determines the country's champion。
race = 游泳可有 race，但整項全國冠軍賽範圍更大。
challenge = 沒有完成任務的意味。
game = 不是單場遊戲。
prize = 不是賽事。

exercises.original: The team won the regional competition and advanced to the national finals.
exercises.zh: 球隊贏得地區錦標賽並晉級全國決賽。

options.explanation: rivalry = 不是長期關係。
championship = 贏得區域層級冠軍後晉級國家賽，regional championship 最自然。
match = 一場 match 不等於地區冠軍賽。
exam = 不合。
cooperation = 不合。
performance = 不是賽事。

exercises.original: He defended his title successfully in this year's competition.
exercises.zh: 他在今年的錦標賽中成功衛冕。

options.explanation: contest = 可泛指比賽，但 defended his title 是 championship 的強烈線索。
challenge = 不是一般完成任務。
championship = defended his title 表示為冠軍頭銜而賽，因此 championship 最精確。
race = 未指速度競賽。
opponent = 不是活動。
prize = title 不是在 prize 中衛冕。

words.note: 除速度比賽外，也可比喻表示多人或機構爭取同一目標、職位或先機。
words.example: Three companies are in a race to launch the product first.
words.exampleZh: 三家公司正在競逐率先推出產品。

exercises.original: Several companies are in competition to develop the first commercially viable battery of this type.
exercises.zh: 數家公司正競逐率先開發出首款具有商業可行性的此類電池。

options.explanation: tournament = 企業研發不是錦標賽。
race = first 是關鍵：多家公司爭取率先完成目標，因此 race 最貼切。
contest = 可理解但 race to develop first 更自然突出搶先。
championship = 沒有冠軍頭銜。
game = 不合。
exam = 不合。

exercises.original: The competition to find a replacement for the retiring director has already begun.
exercises.zh: 爭取接替即將退休董事職位的競逐已經開始。

options.explanation: tournament = 職位競逐不是多輪運動賽。
game = 不合。
race = 多名候選人爭取同一職位，而且有先後勝出意味，可自然稱 race。
performance = 不是活動。
prize = 職位不是 prize 本身。
cooperation = 不是合作。

exercises.original: The two laboratories are in competition to produce a vaccine before winter.
exercises.zh: 兩間實驗室正競逐在冬季前研發出疫苗。

options.explanation: rivalry = 可能存在 rivalry，但 before winter 突出誰先完成。
championship = 不合研發語境。
challenge = 可指技術挑戰，但本句是兩方搶先。
race = before winter 加上兩間實驗室誰先完成，最自然是 in a race to...。
match = 不合。
prize = 不合。

words.note: 較正式、描述性，泛指以比較表現並決出名次或勝負為目的的活動。
words.example: The festival includes several competitive events for young musicians.
words.exampleZh: 這個節慶包括數項為年輕音樂家而設的競賽活動。

exercises.original: The festival includes several competitions for young musicians.
exercises.zh: 這個節慶包括數項為年輕音樂家而設的競賽活動。
exercises.upgrade: competitive event · 競賽活動；比賽項目

options.explanation: performances = 演出未必會比較名次；本句明確是 competitions。
games = 音樂競賽不適合泛稱 games。
competitive event = 節慶中包含多個以評比和決出結果為目的的活動，因此正式總稱 competitive events 最合適。
prizes = 獎項不是活動本身。
exams = 不是考試。
conflicts = 沒有衝突。

exercises.original: Schools may enter students in up to three competitions during the festival.
exercises.zh: 學校可安排學生參加節慶中的最多三項競賽活動。
exercises.upgrade: competitive event · 競賽活動；比賽項目

options.explanation: performances = 如果只是 performance 通常不說 enter in as competition。
messages = 完全不合。
prizes = 學生不是參加獎品。
competitive event = enter students in 多個活動，且活動有競賽性，因此 competitive events 很自然。
opponents = 不是活動。
exams = 節慶競賽不等於考試。

exercises.original: The program lists each competition separately, together with its rules and judging criteria.
exercises.zh: 節目表把每項競賽活動連同規則和評審標準分別列出。
exercises.upgrade: competitive event · 競賽活動；比賽項目

options.explanation: game = 不是所有活動都是遊戲。
performance = 有 judging criteria 仍可能是比賽，但本句泛指各種 competition。
prize = rules/judging criteria 屬活動，不屬獎品。
competitor = 是人。
competitive event = rules and judging criteria 說明這些都是正式競賽項目，因此 competitive event 最精確。
cooperation = 不是競賽。

words.note: 較口語而且語氣較強，表示兩個主要對手之間關鍵、備受注目的最後較量。
words.example: The final became a showdown between the two top-ranked players.
words.exampleZh: 決賽成為兩名最高排名選手之間的正面對決。

exercises.original: The final competition brought the two top-ranked players face to face.
exercises.zh: 最後比賽讓兩名最高排名選手正面對決。
exercises.upgrade: showdown · 決勝較量；正面對決

options.explanation: tournament = 整個 tournament 可包含 final，但本句聚焦最後正面對決。
rivalry = 可能是長期關係，但不是這場關鍵 final 本身。
challenge = 沒有完成任務的意思。
showdown = final、two top-ranked players、face to face 都突出關鍵正面對決，因此 showdown 最貼切。
prize = 不是對決。
exam = 不合。

exercises.original: The last round of the competition was a direct contest between the defending champion and the newcomer.
exercises.zh: 比賽最後一輪是衛冕冠軍與新秀之間的直接對決。
exercises.upgrade: showdown · 決勝較量；正面對決

options.explanation: cooperation = 與直接對決相反。
game = 太中性，沒有關鍵決勝意味。
prize = 不是活動。
performance = 不是雙方對抗。
showdown = last round 加上 defending champion vs newcomer 形成戲劇性決勝局，因此 showdown 很自然。
exam = 不合。

exercises.original: The competition for first place came down to the two strongest teams.
exercises.zh: 第一名之爭最終變成兩支最強隊伍之間的決勝較量。
exercises.upgrade: showdown · 決勝較量；正面對決

options.explanation: tournament = 這裡不是整個賽制，而是最後兩隊之間的決勝。
rivalry = 不一定長期。
challenge = 不合。
prize = 不是活動。
performance = 不是對決。
showdown = came down to two strongest teams 表示最後關鍵對決，因此 showdown 最準確。

words.note: 表示多人、團隊或組織為同一職位、資源、獎項或目標而競爭。
words.example: The contest for the leadership position became increasingly intense.
words.exampleZh: 對領導職位的競逐變得愈來愈激烈。

exercises.original: Competition for the leadership position became increasingly intense.
exercises.zh: 對領導職位的競逐變得愈來愈激烈。
exercises.upgrade: contest for · 對……的競逐；爭奪

options.explanation: tournament for = 職位競爭不是 tournament。
game for = 搭配不自然。
exam for = 不是考試。
prize for = prize for 是獎項用途，不是爭奪本身。
contest for = 多人爭取同一 leadership position，contest for 能自然表示對職位的競逐。
cooperation for = 意思不合。

exercises.original: The competition for the final scholarship attracted more than one hundred applicants.
exercises.zh: 最後一個獎學金名額吸引逾百名申請者競逐。
exercises.upgrade: contest for · 對……的競逐；爭奪

options.explanation: race for = 也可用，但申請／甄選語境中 contest for 更中性。
tournament for = 不合獎學金。
game for = 不自然。
performance for = 不是表演。
opponent for = 不是競賽關係。
contest for = 一百多名 applicants 爭同一 scholarship，這是清楚的 contest for。

exercises.original: Competition for control of the company continued for months.
exercises.zh: 對公司控制權的爭奪持續了數月。
exercises.upgrade: contest for · 對……的競逐；爭奪

options.explanation: contest for = control of the company 是多方爭奪的目標，因此 contest for control 是自然搭配。
championship for = 控制權不是冠軍頭銜。
match for = 不合企業權力競逐。
exam for = 不合。
cooperation for = 意思相反。
prize for = 不合。

words.note: 較形象、較強烈，表示為市場、職位、控制權或其他重要目標進行激烈競爭。
words.example: The battle for market share intensified after the new competitor entered.
words.exampleZh: 新競爭者加入後，市場佔有率之爭更加激烈。

exercises.original: Competition for market share intensified after the new company entered the sector.
exercises.zh: 新公司進入行業後，市場佔有率之爭更加激烈。
exercises.upgrade: battle for · 爭奪；激烈競爭

options.explanation: tournament for = 市場競爭不是賽事。
exam for = 不合。
game for = 太輕且不自然。
cooperation for = 與 intensified competition 相反。
performance for = 不合。
battle for = market share intensified 表示商業競爭非常激烈，因此形象說法 battle for market share 最貼切。

exercises.original: The competition for customers has become fierce as more brands enter the market.
exercises.zh: 更多品牌進入市場後，爭奪顧客的競爭變得激烈。
exercises.upgrade: battle for · 爭奪；激烈競爭

options.explanation: battle for = fierce + more brands 競逐 customers，適合用較強烈的 battle for customers。
challenge for = challenge for customers 搭配不自然。
championship for = 不合商業語境。
prize for = 顧客不是獎品。
match for = 不合。
cooperation for = 意思相反。

exercises.original: The competition for political influence continued behind the scenes.
exercises.zh: 對政治影響力的爭奪在幕後持續。
exercises.upgrade: battle for · 爭奪；激烈競爭

options.explanation: tournament = 不是正式賽事。
battle for = 多方暗中激烈爭奪 political influence，因此 battle for 能準確表達強烈程度。
game = 可比喻但太泛。
exam = 不合。
performance = 不合。
cooperation = 意思相反。

words.note: 強調取得某個稀缺機會、資源或位置並不容易，競爭過程帶有困難和壓力。
words.example: The struggle for affordable housing has become more intense.
words.exampleZh: 對可負擔住房的競爭變得更加激烈。

exercises.original: Competition for affordable housing has become more intense in the city.
exercises.zh: 城市中對可負擔住房的競爭變得更激烈。

options.explanation: struggle for = affordable housing 稀缺而且取得困難，struggle for 能突出競爭中的壓力與艱難。
tournament for = 住房不是 tournament prize。
game for = 不自然。
championship for = 不合。
performance for = 不合。
cooperation for = 不是合作。

exercises.original: There is strong competition for places on the training program.
exercises.zh: 培訓計劃名額競爭激烈。

options.explanation: prize for = 名額不是獎品。
struggle for = places 數量有限而申請者眾多，重點是爭取稀缺名額，因此 struggle for 合適。
game for = 不合。
tournament for = 不合。
opponent for = 不合。
cooperation for = 相反。

exercises.original: Competition for limited water supplies often increases during droughts.
exercises.zh: 乾旱期間，對有限水資源的競爭經常加劇。

options.explanation: contest = 可泛指競爭，但 drought + limited supplies 更突出資源爭奪的艱難。
tournament = 不是比賽賽制。
struggle for = limited water supplies 和 drought 表示資源不足造成艱難競逐，因此 struggle for 最精確。
game = 不合嚴肅資源語境。
prize = 水不是獎項。
exam = 不合。

words.note: 當 competition 指市場或工作環境中由其他競爭者造成的壓力時，可用這個較正式說法。
words.example: Small retailers face growing competitive pressure from online platforms.
words.exampleZh: 小型零售商面對來自網上平台日益增加的競爭壓力。

exercises.original: Small retailers face increasing competition from large online platforms.
exercises.zh: 小型零售商面對來自大型網上平台日益增加的競爭壓力。

options.explanation: tournament = 零售市場不是錦標賽。
competitive pressure = face increasing ... from large online platforms 描述競爭者施加的市場壓力，因此 competitive pressure 最準確。
contest = 可以比喻，但 face ... pressure 更精確描述市場壓力。
challenge = 大型平台確實構成 challenge，但原句特別是來自競爭者的市場壓力。
prize = 不合。
cooperation = 相反。

exercises.original: The company lowered prices because of strong competition in the market.
exercises.zh: 公司因市場競爭壓力強烈而降低價格。

options.explanation: rivalry = 可描述企業間競爭關係，但降價是對市場壓力的反應。
tournament = 不合。
competitive pressure = 公司因競爭而被迫降價，重點是 competition 對決策造成 pressure，因此這個說法最貼切。
showdown = 太戲劇化且偏單次對決。
prize = 不合。
exam = 不合。

exercises.original: Intense competition is forcing manufacturers to improve quality and reduce costs.
exercises.zh: 激烈競爭正迫使製造商提升質素並降低成本。

options.explanation: contest = contest 是賽事／競逐，不自然作 forcing manufacturers 的抽象力量。
rivalry = 可存在 rivalry，但本句重點是迫使企業行動的壓力。
challenge = 較泛。
competitive pressure = is forcing manufacturers 直接顯示競爭形成壓力，因此 competitive pressure 最自然。
championship = 不合。
game = 不合。

words.note: 強調兩個主要參賽者、隊伍或方案直接比較和較量。
words.example: The election developed into a head-to-head contest between the two leading candidates.
words.exampleZh: 這場選舉演變成兩名主要候選人之間的正面較量。

exercises.original: The competition became a direct battle between the two strongest finalists.
exercises.zh: 比賽變成兩名最強決賽者之間的直接較量。
exercises.upgrade: head-to-head contest · 正面較量；一對一競賽

options.explanation: tournament = 整個 tournament 可有多名參賽者；本句只剩 two finalists 直接對決。
rivalry = 未必是長期關係。
head-to-head contest = two strongest finalists + direct battle 表示一對一正面較量，因此 head-to-head contest 最準確。
challenge = 沒有任務意味。
prize = 不是活動。
cooperation = 相反。

exercises.original: After the other candidates withdrew, the competition was between just two people.
exercises.zh: 其他候選人退出後，競爭只剩兩個人。
exercises.upgrade: head-to-head contest · 正面較量；一對一競賽

options.explanation: tournament = 兩名候選人的競逐不是錦標賽。
championship = 不是冠軍賽。
cooperation = 相反。
head-to-head contest = just two people 是關鍵線索，表示競爭變成直接一對一，因此 head-to-head contest 最貼切。
exam = 不合。
prize = 不合。

exercises.original: The final competition compared the two designs directly against each other.
exercises.zh: 最後比賽把兩個設計直接互相比較。
exercises.upgrade: head-to-head contest · 正面較量；一對一競賽

options.explanation: race = 沒有誰先完成的時間競逐。
rivalry = 設計之間不是長期對手關係。
tournament = 只有兩個方案直接比較。
performance = 不是比賽本身。
head-to-head contest = directly against each other 表示兩個方案正面比較，因此 head-to-head contest 很自然。
prize = 不是活動。

falseSynonyms.zh: 一場遊戲／球賽不一定等於競賽 game 可以只是娛樂或某項運動的一場比賽；competition 更強調爭勝或比較表現。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON A game may be played for fun. A competition is organized to compare competitors and determine a result.

falseSynonyms.zh: 獎品不等於比賽 prize 是勝出後得到的獎勵，不是比賽本身。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The competition has a cash prize for the winner.

falseSynonyms.zh: 參賽者不等於競賽 competitor 是參加競爭的人或機構；competition 是競爭過程或賽事。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON Several competitors entered the competition.

falseSynonyms.zh: 對手不等於競賽 opponent 是在比賽中與你對抗的人或隊伍，不是整個 competition。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON She defeated her opponent in the final competition round.

falseSynonyms.zh: 表現不等於比賽 performance 是參賽者的表現；比賽可能根據 performance 評分。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON His performance was excellent, but the competition was very close.

falseSynonyms.zh: 考試不一定是競賽 exam 用來測試知識或能力，通常不是參加者彼此爭勝。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON All students took the exam, but only some entered the competition.

falseSynonyms.zh: 衝突不等於競爭 conflict 強調矛盾、爭執或對抗；competition 可以和平而有規則。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The firms are in competition, but they are not necessarily in conflict.

falseSynonyms.zh: 合作不等於競爭 cooperation 表示共同合作，通常和 competition 的核心關係相反。
falseSynonyms.point: ENGLISH COMPARISON The teams compete during the event but cooperate on safety arrangements.
